subject: health
concept: Applying individual/population health, disease spread, social determinants, data-informed policy, policy tradeoffs, and campaign design to a real-world scenario, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student analyzes a realistic public health scenario using multiple concepts from this unit
exercise.abstract: Student proposes a response to the scenario, referencing at least two concepts from this unit

assessment.mastery_threshold: response genuinely applies at least two concepts from this unit
misconception_flags: proposes a response with no connection to any concept actually covered in this unit

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
